name: AI Blocks Studio – for Gutenberg
author: Ibrahim

sections.description:
AI Blocks Studio allows you to generate complete Gutenberg block sections using artificial intelligence. Simply describe what you want to create, and the plugin will generate the native WordPress blocks for you.

Features:
* Support for OpenAI (GPT-4o), Google Gemini, Mistral AI, and Anthropic Claude.
* Generates native WordPress blocks that are fully editable.
* Easy-to-use admin interface for API configuration.
* Modern block editor integration.

External services

This plugin uses third-party AI services to generate block content based on your prompts. Your prompts are sent to the AI provider you select in the settings.

  1. OpenAI

    • Used for generating block structures and content.
    • Data sent: The text prompt you provide.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-blocks-generator-studio folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘AI Blocks Studio’ in the admin menu to configure your API keys.
sections.faq:
Which AI models are supported?

OpenAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, and Claude are supported.

Can I edit the generated blocks?

Yes, all generated content is made of native WordPress blocks, so you can edit them as usual.
